answer: Time-locked collateral bonds deter Sybil attacks among bots mapping a meadow, river ripple, or wooded knoll. Each agent locks a minimum token stake in a smart-contract escrow for a full epoch to earn network routing rights, while verifiable fraud proofs slash misbehaving deposits. Freezing capital forces adversaries to bear real liquidity and opportunity costs per alias, though wealthy operators can still fund many compliant identities.
